notes: Giving the relative element of *whither* to the waw under rule 17 was the competing reading; `שָׁמָּה` with its directive `he` is the morpheme whose sense the single word carries, so the fusion is theirs and the waw is left `unrepresented` (rules 22, 30, 32).
`הָיָה` present in the possessive clause takes the *have*, the `לְ` goes `unrepresented`, and the suffix takes the subject pronoun (rules 43, 40).
`מִחוּץ` is rendered by the single word *without* here, so the pair shares one unit headed on the construct noun.
